gcp.pubsub.export.note: BigQuery and Cloud Storage subscriptions per TiB read from the subscription and written, the same in every region, with no free tier. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.pubsub.storage.note: Message storage: retained acknowledged messages, snapshots and unacknowledged backlog older than a day, the same in every region. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.
